name: morandi-cinematic-poster-zeejay
title_zh: 把一张旅行照做成莫兰迪色电影海报
tagline_zh: 不用星空、不用拼贴，只靠排版与留白，把建筑或街景照片变成有电影感的文艺海报。适合想给旅行照换个高级出路的你。
tagline_en: Turn one travel photo into a Morandi-toned film poster with typography and negative space—no stars, no collage.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied personal photograph into a source-faithful, typography-driven Morandi cinematic poster without stars or decorative collage symbols. Use film-poster title design, optional poetic byline and tagline, atmospheric metadata, optional fictional credits, intentional negative-space placement, perspective alignment, and selective subject occlusion. why_zh: 它不套滤镜，而是按电影海报的排版逻辑重构画面：标题字、诗句、留白、遮挡关系都按透视对齐。
why_en: No filter presets—it rebuilds your photo using film-poster typography, perspective-aware negative space, and selective.
limit_zh: 只吃单张个人照片，且主体需是建筑或街景；人像、宠物、纯风景会被强制加遮挡或裁切。输出是海报构图方案与排版指引。
limit_en: Only single personal photos with architecture/street subjects; portraits, pets, or pure landscapes get forced crops or occlusion. Output is a layout.
